0022600127.text: The Golden State Warriors (0-3, 15th in the West) visit the Denver Nuggets (1-1, 8th in the West) for their fourth game of the season, with the Warriors on a three-game losing streak and 0-2 on the road. Golden State is listed as out without Al Horford, Brandin Podziemski, Draymond Green (back), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Stephen Curry (rest), and Gui Santos is day-to-day with a game-time decision, while Denver is missing Alpha Diallo (wrist), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 and split their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the Warriors losing the last meeting 116-93 in Denver on March 29, 2026.
